title: Cofactor target, normalized scalar comparisons and local formula predicate
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $P,Q$ be $A$-modules, $c\geq0$, and $u:P\to Q$ be $A$-linear. Write $V^\vee=\operatorname{Hom}_A(V,A)$. Using exterior powers [def-weil-pbc-exterior-algebra] and tensor products [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product], define $D_{P,Q,c}=(\bigwedge_A^cP)^\vee\otimes_A\bigwedge_A^{c+1}Q$. For an ordered basis $p=(p_1,\ldots,p_c)$ of $P$ and $v\in Q$, define its cofactor basis value to be $(p_1\wedge\cdots\wedge p_c)^\vee\otimes(u(p_1)\wedge\cdots\wedge u(p_c)\wedge v)$, with the dual basis wedge functional defined by the determinant pairing of the coordinate forms.
For a commutative $A$-algebra $B$, put $P_B=B\otimes_AP$, $Q_B=B\otimes_AQ$ and $u_B=B\otimes_Au$. A normalized cofactor scalar comparison consists of $B$-linear isomorphisms $s:B\otimes_A\bigwedge_A^cP\to\bigwedge_B^cP_B$, $t:B\otimes_A\bigwedge_A^{c+1}Q\to\bigwedge_B^{c+1}Q_B$, $d:B\otimes_A(\bigwedge_A^cP)^\vee\to(\bigwedge_B^cP_B)^\vee$, $L:B\otimes_AD_{P,Q,c}\to D_{P_B,Q_B,c}$ and $K:B\otimes_A(Q/u(P))\to Q_B/u_B(P_B)$, with these normalization equations: $s(b\otimes\bigwedge_i x_i)=b\bigwedge_i(1\otimes x_i)$ and likewise $t$ on $(c+1)$-fold wedges; $d(b\otimes\lambda)(s(b'\otimes x))=bb'\lambda(x)$; $L(b\otimes(\lambda\otimes y))=d(b\otimes\lambda)\otimes t(1\otimes y)$; and $K(b\otimes\bar v)=\overline{b\otimes v}$. Scalars from $A$ in these equations are mapped to $B$ by its algebra map. This is a type of specified data, not an assertion that such comparisons exist for arbitrary modules and algebras.
Given such comparisons $e_S$ for every localization $B=S^{-1}A$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization] and an $A$-linear $w:Q/u(P)\to D_{P,Q,c}$, define the local cofactor predicate to mean that for every $S$, every ordered basis $p$ of $P_B$ of length $c$, and every $v\in Q_B$, one has $L_S((B\otimes_Aw)(K_S^{-1}(\bar v)))$ equal to the cofactor basis value of $(u_B,p,v)$. The definition includes the empty basis, the zero ring and noninjective $u$; it imposes no finite-projectivity, rank or existence assertion.

def IsLocalCofactor {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    {P : Type v} {Q : Type w} [AddCommGroup P] [Module A P]
    [AddCommGroup Q] [Module A Q] (u : P →ₗ[A] Q) (c : ℕ)
    (e : ∀ S : Submonoid A, CofactorScalarComparison (Localization S) u c)
    (w : (Q ⧸ LinearMap.range u) →ₗ[A] CofactorTarget A P Q c) : Prop
